logic:identity.instructions: An explicit identity/equality claim; a predication using is alone does not establish identity.

logic:reflexivity.instructions: An identity or relation explicitly applied from an object to itself.

logic:symmetry.instructions: Both directions of the same identity/relation are represented.

logic:transitivity.instructions: A-to-B and B-to-C are composed to reach A-to-C.

logic:modus_ponens.instructions: Performed pattern: P→Q and P supplied; therefore Q.

logic:modus_tollens.instructions: Performed pattern: P→Q and NOT Q supplied; therefore NOT P.

logic:and_introduction.instructions: Performed pattern: P and Q supplied separately; therefore P AND Q.

logic:and_elimination.instructions: Performed pattern: P AND Q supplied; therefore P or therefore Q.

logic:or_introduction.instructions: A supplied proposition produces a disjunction containing it.

logic:disjunctive_syllogism.instructions: Performed pattern: P OR Q and NOT P supplied; therefore Q (or exchanged).

logic:hypothetical_syllogism.instructions: Performed pattern: P→Q and Q→R supplied; therefore P→R.

axis:argument_direction.instructions: Assess the direction of the main ordered relation, using the candidate argument order when available.

criteria.unresolved: No ordered candidate or uncertain binding.

axis:premise_status.instructions: Assess premises of the proposed inference, distinguishing assertion from supposition.

criteria.unresolved: No inference or uncertain premise status.

axis:premise_sufficiency.instructions: Assess whether the stated inference has its required premises. Do not invent bridging claims.

criteria.missing: At least one required premise absent.

axis:rule_pattern.instructions: Assess whether the candidate named rule matches its actual premise/conclusion pattern; entailment alone does not establish modus ponens.

criteria.matches: The named standard rule pattern matches.
criteria.mismatches: The named pattern does not match.

axis:identity_basis.instructions: Assess support for the proposed identity; is alone is insufficient.

criteria.inferred: Identity requires an interpretation or inference.

axis:reply_role.instructions: Classify the reply relative to its preceding question or claim, retaining dialogue context.
